texts.zh: [from.planet.GetName]乍一看是一颗普通的宜居行星，但我们的研究团队详细调查后发现了许多大型的化石矿藏，而且保存状况相当良好。有趣的是，一些大型的化石群在同一地层中包含许多物种，这表明要么它们是在同一时间死去，要么就是被人刻意这样安置的。对这些遗骸的检测让我们有机会进一步了解这颗行星上生活的物种的进化轨迹。
texts.en: [from.planet.GetName] appears to be a standard habitable planet, but on closer inspection, our research team has spotted large deposits of fossils in seemingly well-preserved conditions. Interestingly, larger clusters contain multiple specimens on the same layer, indicating that they either died at the same time or were placed there intentionally. Examination of these remains gives us the opportunity to better understand the evolutionary process of the species inhabiting this planet.

sections.zh: [from.planet.GetName]乍一看是一颗普通的宜居行星，但我们的研究团队详细调查后发现了许多大型的化石矿藏，而且保存状况相当良好。有趣的是，一些大型的化石群在同一地层中包含许多物种，这表明要么它们是在同一时间死去，要么就是被人刻意这样安置的。对这些遗骸的检测让我们有机会进一步了解这颗行星上生活的物种的进化轨迹。
sections.en: [from.planet.GetName] appears to be a standard habitable planet, but on closer inspection, our research team has spotted large deposits of fossils in seemingly well-preserved conditions. Interestingly, larger clusters contain multiple specimens on the same layer, indicating that they either died at the same time or were placed there intentionally. Examination of these remains gives us the opportunity to better understand the evolutionary process of the species inhabiting this planet.

texts.zh:
我们对地表进行扫描后确定了一些有价值的矿藏，其中埋有不计其数的不同物种的遗骸。有些甚至与目前仍生活在这颗星球上的一些生物相仿，其他的则与我们所见过的生物截然不同。

尽管这项工作并不容易，周围的野生动物也被我们惊扰，但[leader.GetName]还是已经有了重要的发现，并成功地重建了一些已经灭绝的物种。但这也反过来引起了研究团队的一些争论。其中一些人想展出这些标本，而另一些则更愿意进一步研究这些材料，毕竟这些化石已经是保存状况最好的一批，而这个矿点也即将被挖空了。
texts.en:
We scanned the surface and found a few promising deposits, filled with the remains of a variety of different species. Some resemble those still living on the surface, while others are nothing like we have seen before.

Although the work is hard and the wildlife is agitated by our presence, [leader.GetName] has already made remarkable discoveries and managed to reconstruct some of the extinct species. This, in turn, sparked a dispute among the research team. While some want to display these species in exhibitions, others prefer to study the material, as they are the best-preserved fossils found to date, and this dig site is almost exhausted.

label.en: Make an exhibition out of them.

texts.zh: 我们已经开展了充分的研究，探明了化石物种和[from.planet.GetName]当前生物圈中各物种之间的关系。结果证明，它们中的一些属于同一属种，具有许多相似性。进一步的研究或许能够带给我们更多答案。
texts.en: We have done extensive research to determine the relationship of fossil species to the current biosphere on [from.planet.GetName]. It turns out that some of them belong to the same genus, having many similarities. Further studies might bring us more answers.

texts.zh: 不少人前来参观我们的展览。尽管我们不能将收集到的东西用于研究，但我们还是吸引到了几位慷慨的赞助商，将这些化石送去举办行星际巡回展览。展品的异星外观在那些对外星考古学有兴趣的人中间引起了小规模的热烈反响。
texts.en: Quite a few people came to our exhibition. Although we can't use the collected material for our research, we attracted some generous funders and sent the fossils on an interplanetary tour. The alien appearance of exhibits caused a small boom of people interested in xenoarchaeology.

texts.zh:
将第一个考古遗址彻底翻遍之后，我们决定转移到更加偏僻的地方，搜寻更多可供研究用的材料。[leader.GetName]找到了一个相当好的地点，此处是一个洞穴，被一些有智慧但已经灭绝的物种用作居所。在谨慎的探索和检查之后，我们发现了一些非同寻常的事情：不管住在这个洞穴里的是何方神圣，这种生物会使用一种精妙的染料，在光和热的作用下会显出颜色。

我们已经识别出两种彩绘：一种讲述过去的故事，另一种描绘了日常生活。不幸的是，由于我们的闯入，让彩绘得以保留下来的精妙生态系统遭到扰乱。这种扰乱产生的一系列连锁反应，加之染料本身经历的岁月，导致这些彩绘会在短时间内消失。小队必须立马决定抢救哪一种更有价值的彩绘。
texts.en:
Exhausting the first site, we decided to move to more remote places in search of more material for research. [leader.GetName] found a good enough spot, a cave that served as a home for some intelligent extinct species. Careful probing and examination revealed something unusual: whatever lived in this cave used an ingenious dye that reveals itself when exposed to heat and light.

We have identified two types of paintings: one telling the story of the past, and the other portraying daily life. Unfortunately, we disrupted the delicate ecosystem that preserved the drawings. The resulting chain reaction, combined with the age of the dye, causes it to fade and disappear on short notice. The team must decide which one is worth saving.

texts.zh: 我们获取的彩绘讲述了这个物种的过往，给予我们许多有关它们历史的新认识。看上去，这些穴居者同某个高级文明进行了接触，这在某种程度上影响了它们的外形和发展路线。根据这些生物的外形描述，我们猜测该物种能够快速地进行基因变异，几代之内其外表就会发生显著变化。
texts.en: We captured drawings related to the past and gained insight into the species' history. It appears that these cave dwellers came into contact with an advanced civilization that somewhat influenced their looks and development. Given the depictions of the creatures, we assume that the species was prone to rapid genetic mutations, and their generations varied greatly in appearance.

texts.zh: 我们获取的彩绘讲述了这个物种的日常生活，给予我们许多有关它们历史的新认识。彩绘将穴居者描绘成一群外形看上去迥乎不同，但智力水平相近的物种，正在参加复杂的仪式。[leader.GetName]假设，这是各种各样的生物沐浴在神明的圣光之下，为祂工作，以换取神赐的自由。
texts.en: We captured drawings related to daily life and gained insight into the history of the species. They depict cave dwellers as a conglomeration of different-looking but similarly intelligent species who participated in complex rituals. [leader.GetName] assumed that the various creatures basked in the light of the deity, worked for him, and in return were given freedom.

texts.zh:
我们进一步探索这个洞穴的裂缝深处，来到了一处人工岩室，里面有一个古怪的骨质结构。鉴于这个结构当前的状态，它看上去好像发生了坍塌，然后沉到了地里面——可能是一场地震导致的。[Leader.GetName]下令在原地扎营，我们也已在周边进行了一些探测，但地面并不是很稳定。一旦我们进入内部，我们可能不会有充足的时间对这个结构进行彻底的检查。

对我们的研究来说，最大的潜在成果就是这座建筑本身。我们可以研究这种精巧的类骨物质，或者将精力放在探索上，搜寻这个结构内部更多有关外星人的线索——了解是谁建造了它，怎么使用它，这些人的日常生活是怎样的。
texts.en:
Exploring further into the deep chasms of the cave, we came across a grotto with a strange bone structure inside. Given the current state of the structure, it looks like it collapsed and sank into the ground - probably as a result of an earthquake. [Leader.GetName] ordered a camp to be set up, and we have already done some perimeter scans, but the ground is not stable. We may not have adequate time to examine the structure fully once we get inside.

The greatest potential yield for our studies lies in the building itself. We can either study the intriguing bone-like material or focus our efforts on exploration, searching the structure for more clues about the aliens who built and used it and their daily routine.

texts.zh:
在经过波澜不惊的研究之后，[Leader.GetName]得出的结论是这座建筑曾经是……活着的。当然不是现在，而是很多年前，在它被创造出来的某个时候。一大堆骨和组织被粘合在了一起，建造出了这样一栋建筑，能够根据特定的需求变形。考虑到这座建筑坍塌的方式，我们或许甚至可以假设这是结构的这一部分故意执行的行为。

不幸的是，我们在研究过程中不小心破坏了这个结构，它坍塌得更加厉害了，致使这座建筑无法用于我们的进一步研究。[Leader.GetName]下令小队继续前进。
texts.en:
After uneventful research, [Leader.GetName] concluded that the building was... alive. Not now, but years ago, sometime during its creation. It was a mass of bones and tissues molded together to create a building that could reshape for the desired purpose. Given the way the building collapsed, one might even assume that this was a deliberate act on the part of the structure itself.

Unfortunately, we compromised the structure during our studies and it collapsed even further, rendering the building useless for further research. [Leader.GetName] ordered the team to move forward.

texts.zh:
这个阴森的结构内部原来是一座迷宫，满是半坍塌的廊道，地上到处都是四散分布的类骨物质。在历经磨难之后，我们设法取出了几样工具和物体，这些都昭示着某个复合的文化势力曾一度生活在这个行星上。它们或许能够提供给我们新的认识，让我们了解这些灭绝的物种究竟是怎样的生命。

不幸的是，在我们的研究过程中，不小心破坏了这个结构，它坍塌得更加厉害了，致使这座建筑无法用于我们得进一步研究。[Leader.GetName]下令小队继续前进。
texts.en:
The interior of this creepy structure turned out to be a maze of half-collapsed corridors filled with bone-like material lying everywhere. With some difficulty, we were able to extract several tools and objects that indicate that a complex culture lived on this planet. They will give us great insight into what life may have been like for these extinct species.

Unfortunately, we compromised the structure during our studies and it collapsed even further, rendering the building useless for further research. [Leader.GetName] has ordered the team to move forward.

texts.zh:
我们终于抵达了洞穴的最里面。我们进入了某座深深地埋在地底下、看上去像是古旧的废弃地堡一样的建筑。它看上去同我们先前找到的任何东西都不一样：我们只能假设是某些外星访客在这里设置了一个研究实验室。根据破旧的地堡、各种各样的骨头、还有四散的化石，显然他们以前也在研究这些物种，正同我们现在做的一样……唯一的区别是，他们能够趁着这些物种还活着的时候，在它们身上做各种实验。

我们刚一恢复考古遗址和数据库的电源供给，[Leader.GetName]立马就开始了工作，试图将其中收集到的任何有用的信息归纳到一起。
texts.en:
We finally reached the end of the cave. We entered something that resembled an old abandoned bunker built deep underground. It doesn't look like anything we've found before: we assume alien visitors set up a research lab down here. And given the dilapidated tanks, various bones, and fossils lying around, they were studying these species just as we were... Only they had this opportunity to conduct research when their specimens were still alive.

[Leader.GetName] immediately jumped to work, trying to gather any useful information from the site and data banks, as soon as we plugged them into the power source.

label.zh: 我们发现了怎样的谜题？

texts.zh:
我们将先前研究中得到的知识和数据库中的信息进行了比照。得出的结论让人寒颤。很显然，几千年前，某个能够太空航行的文明降落到了这个星球上，发现这些土生土长的物种在使用了他们掌握的基因操纵技术后，能够很容易地驯服。最开始，他们将有智慧的人群——尽管尚未完全开发——土人奴役，并且在它们身上进行各种各样的实验。这些实验包括为了建造目的将它们转化为活体建材。除此之外还有顺从的奴隶。甚至宠物或者牲口。

我们先前发现的实例很有可能就是这些物种的遗体，彼时它们尚未退化为现今[from.planet.GetName]上郁郁葱葱的非智慧生物圈的一部分。对于一个在未来的某一天能够像我们一样横贯整个星系的物种来说，这真是一个骇人的结局。
texts.en:
We compared our knowledge from previous studies to the information from the databanks. The conclusion we made is disconcerting. It appears that thousands of years ago, a space-faring civilization landed on this world and found the indigenous specimens easy to train, using their genetic manipulation techniques. At first, they enslaved the population of intelligent - albeit not fully-developed - autochthons, and conducted various experiments on them. These included making them into living tissue for construction purposes. Or into obedient slaves. Or into pets and livestock.

The previous instances we found were probably remnants of these species before they devolved into the non-sapient biosphere that now thrives on the [from.planet.GetName]. A horrifying end for a species that could, one day, have traversed the galaxy just as we do.

texts.zh:
很显然，几千年前，一个先进的文明发现了居住在这里的物种，并且很有兴趣研究它们。他们因当地多样化的生物圈而着迷。老旧的数据库仍旧可以运转，里面记录了奇怪的结论和让人不得不忧心的实验。数据库里面包含了这个物种的一个基本基因构成，以及它们在过去和将来是如何进行演化的。

这些研究者自身发生了什么？他们退化成了我们先前发现的穴居者吗？或者正相反，这些研究者就是从穴居者中间进化而来的，在某个时间点离开了这颗行星？这一切不禁让我们思索：宇宙还容纳了怎样的谜团？
texts.en:
It appears that thousands of years ago, an advanced civilization found the specimens living here to be an interesting study. They were, fascinated by the diverse biosphere. Old databanks are still working, filled with strange conclusions and somewhat worrying experiments. They contain a basic genetic composition of the species and how they might have developed in the past and future.

What happened to the researchers themselves? Did they devolve to the state of cave dwellers we found before? Or maybe it is the opposite, and they evolved from them, leaving the planet at some point? It brings us to wonder: what other mysteries does the universe hold?

label.zh: 这证明了绝不能相信异星人！
label.en: This proves that Xenos can't be trusted!

label.zh: 我们的政府绝对不会犯下如此的骇人罪行！
label.en: Such crimes would be impossible under our government!
The galaxy is a harsh place.
